title: Substrings That Begin and End With the Same Letter
summary: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, count the number of substrings that start and end with the same letter.
statement: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, count the number of substrings that start and end with the same letter. A substring is a continuous sequence of characters within the string.
constraints: s is a nonempty lowercase string.
Count contiguous substrings whose first and last characters are equal.
Return the total including every one-character substring.
hints: When a substring ends at the current character, its start must be an earlier or current occurrence of that character.
Track how many times each character has appeared including the current position.
Increment the character count, then add that count to the answer.
This adds every valid substring exactly at its unique right endpoint.
editorial: This adds every valid substring exactly at its unique right endpoint.

tests.explanation: Five singletons plus abcba and bcb give seven.
The three a occurrences create six a-ended substrings; the other letters add three.
